name: 02-problem
title:
Small tasks keep
pulling you away
sub: For students and busy teams, everyday admin competes with the work they sat down to do.

name: 03-context-switching
title:
One request,
a lot of clicking
sub: Searching, comparing and copying results breaks the flow of a report, a project or a study session.

name: 04-solution
title: Tell THINGS what needs doing
sub: Speak naturally. THINGS shows what it heard and starts the task.

name: 05-desktop
title: A hand with its own task window
sub: THINGS runs beside your work as a Windows application.

name: 06-control
title: You choose what powers it
sub: Connect your own model, follow each action and stop the task when you need to.

name: 08-task-examples
title: One conversation, several requests
sub: The current prototype runs one computer task at a time and queues follow-up requests.

name: 09-pipeline
title: How a request becomes an action
sub: The agent checks the new screen after each step.

name: 11-impact
title:
Less routine clicking
while you work
sub: For someone writing a report, THINGS can take the paper search out of the middle of the writing session.
